title: Historian Health (ingest)
description: Is the plant historian actually receiving data? Measured at the destination, so it detects shipper outages, network partitions, and a stopped control node alike. The control node's own shipper counters (queue depth, drops) are at GET /api/historian/shipper on the Pi — Grafana OSS cannot scrape that without an external plugin, so ingest is measured here instead.

options.content:
A flat line on a process trend has two very different causes: **the value did not change**, or **no data arrived**. Those look identical on a chart and mean opposite things. Check here before drawing a conclusion from a flat or missing trend.

Forwarding is best-effort and at-most-once by design — the control node's local SQLite historian is the authoritative record. A gap here does **not** mean the data is lost, only that it did not reach this database.

panels.title: Ingest lag (time since newest sample)
panels.description: Should stay near the capture interval. Climbing steadily means forwarding has stopped.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(ts))) AS "lag"
FROM tag_sample

SELECT count(DISTINCT tag_id) AS "tags"
FROM tag_sample
WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

SELECT count(*)::float / 60.0 AS "samples/min"
FROM tag_sample
WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

panels.title: Ingest rate — gaps here are forwarding gaps

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', ts) AS time,
       count(*)::float                AS "samples"
FROM tag_sample
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stale tags (no sample in the last hour)
panels.description: A tag that stopped reporting while others continued is an instrument or mapping problem, not a shipper problem.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.name                                   AS "Tag",
       max(s.ts)                                AS "Last sample",
       round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(s.ts)))) AS "Age (s)"
FROM tag_definition t
LEFT JOIN tag_sample s ON s.tag_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.name
HAVING max(s.ts) IS NULL OR max(s.ts) < now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
ORDER BY 2 NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Storage and compression
panels.description: If the compression ratio is closer to 2-3x than 10-20x, check that compress_segmentby = 'tag_id' actually applied — that setting dominates the outcome.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT hypertable_name AS "Table",
       pg_size_pretty(before_compression_total_bytes) AS "Before",
       pg_size_pretty(after_compression_total_bytes)  AS "After",
       round(before_compression_total_bytes::numeric
             / NULLIF(after_compression_total_bytes, 0), 1) AS "Ratio"
FROM hypertable_compression_stats('tag_sample')

panels.title: Continuous aggregate and retention jobs
panels.description: If the 1-minute aggregate stops refreshing, retention will eventually drop raw chunks that were never rolled up — permanent history loss.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT job_id                 AS "Job",
       hypertable_name        AS "Table",
       last_run_status        AS "Status",
       last_successful_finish AS "Last success",
       total_failures         AS "Failures"
FROM timescaledb_information.job_stats
ORDER BY last_successful_finish NULLS FIRST
